notes.title: Heaven Island - the meaning of life
notes.content:
[h1]Hello my friends!
I'm happy to announce a new update regarding 2 of our games:


[b]Heaven Island VR MMO with a new FREE DLC for you that you can download,
it inclued all Artworks and emoticons that you can freely use!	[/b]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/476480/

And Heaven Forest is now available for you to download
a game about the meaning of life




Moreover there is 51% Discount during Christmas sales! ːbuddhaː 	[/h1]

notes.title: Heaven Island Paradisiac Soundtrack now available!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello my friends!
I'm happy to announce that the Heaven Island soundtrack is now available with the following songs:

1. Over the Seaside
2. Relaxing
3. Flutes
4. Inside The Caves
5. Reaching Mindfulness
6. River
7. Sea
8. Waterfall


ːparadisepalmː[/h1]

notes.title: Update Version 1.55! - Server Stability
notes.content:
[h1]Hello my friends! 
Here a new update for you, the main features are:
[b]
- Better server Stability (you can play with the ball now)
- Achivevements fixed
- More animals
- Minor bug fixes
[/b]

Hope you'll like it! ːbuddhaː

Peace ːespritː

	[/h1]

notes.title: Update Version 1.5 - Interactivity!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello my friends!
Here a new cool update for you, here the add-ons ːwoodlefatherː

[b]- Soul customization! ːespritː (you will change colour based on the books you'll read, aquiring self knowledge)

- Interaction with other players! (you'll be able to interact with some object on the island, for example a ball!)

- Number of items collected saved! (you can quit the game and then the status will be saved)

	[/b]

Hope you'll like this new super update :)	[/h1]

notes.title: New Update 1.45! - Vahid edition
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Soul Mates! 
Here a new fresh update for Paradise Island!
[b]
- A LOT of fishes added!
- Jump! (Levitation)
- Mushrooms (in forest)
- Moving Curtains
- Minor Collision problems fixed[/b]

Thanks again for the fantastic support! Stay tuned for further updates! ːthetreeoflifeː	[/h1]
